header: "HOW TO READ A WHEEL (RIM) MARKING": 8Jx20 and its like, part by part, then why the numbers matter (which tyres fit, what else must match the car). It sits UNDER the tyre reader (after the tyre's own specification) as a section of its own, and I made it emerald and teal so that it cannot be mistaken for the tyre's rose; when a tyre has been read, a strip tells which wheel it asks for. The same panel opens by itself when a wheel marking is typed in the search line. It is computed in the browser from src/tools/rim/rim.ts; nothing is stored or sent.
